summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 to ControlType and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member to ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the SET_WINDOW_TITLE formatter (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL) and Control.title(title); rich/_windows_renderer.py dispatches SET_WINDOW_TITLE to term.set_title(title); rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title(title) returning True when written and False when not a terminal. Tests added in tests/test_console.py (skipped on win32), tests/test_control.py, and tests/test_windows_renderer.py (Windows only). CHANGELOG.md has an Unreleased Added entry linking pull request 2200. Not run: tests and Black were not executed per instructions, so formatting and test results are unverified. Nothing committed.
